name: rolling
teaches: A squad that carries over: nobody says IN, the organiser posts 'same lot as last week', people only say when they cannot make it.

history.author: Steve Hart
history.text: Same lot as last week, let me know if you can't do Tuesday

history.author: Kwame Osei
history.text: Can't make it this week, away with work

history.author: Steve Hart
history.text: No worries Kwame, anyone got a mate who can cover?

history.author: Dev Patel
history.text: My brother can play

history.author: Steve Hart
history.text: Sorted, thanks Dev. Everyone else as you were

history.author: Liam Brady
history.text: See you at 9 at Goals North Cheam

history.author: Steve Hart
history.text: Good game last night lads

history.author: Jordan Pike
history.text: Cracking game, my legs are gone
